statement: ∀ (D : ℝ) (Q : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < D → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < D → ENNReal.ofReal (s + 1) ≤ Q) → ENNReal.ofReal (D + 1) ≤ Q
proof:
intro D Q hD h
by_cases hQ : Q = ⊤
· simp [hQ]
apply (ENNReal.ofReal_le_iff_le_toReal hQ).2
apply le_of_forall_lt
intro b hb
have hm : max 0 (b - 1) < D := max_lt hD (by linarith)
obtain ⟨s, hs, hsD⟩ := exists_between hm
have hs0 : 0 < s := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hs
have hbs : b < s + 1 := by
  have : b - 1 < s := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hs
  linarith
exact hbs.trans_le ((ENNReal.ofReal_le_iff_le_toReal hQ).1 (h s hs0 hsD))
